patches_added.name: Pairip DRM Bypass
patches_added.description: Disables Pairip DRM/integrity checks that crash patched APKs on startup.

patches_modified.name: Branding
patches_modified.description: Changes app name to 'Scanner Radio+' for easy identification.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.

patches_added.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches_added.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_added.name: Disable the long press repost
patches_added.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_added.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches_added.description: Puts the whole of a vertical video on screen instead of cropping it to the window. On a 9:16 phone nothing changes, because the video already fills it. On a Fold opened up, a squarer phone or a split view the sides or the ends stop being cut off.

patches_added.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches_added.description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, raised by its BdTuring service, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches_added.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone.

patches_added.name: Show LIVE search
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_added.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_added.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_added.name: Skip content warnings
patches_added.description: Adds an option to play videos TikTok has classified without the warning overlay asking to be tapped through first.

patches_added.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_added.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_removed.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_removed.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_removed.name: Disable long-press repost
patches_removed.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_removed.name: Enable Live search
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_removed.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_removed.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_removed.name: Fit video to the screen
patches_removed.description: Puts the whole of a vertical video on screen instead of cropping it to the window. On a 9:16 phone nothing changes, because the video already fills it. On a Fold opened up, a squarer phone or a split view the sides or the ends stop being cut off. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches_removed.name: Hide BdTuring CAPTCHA popups
patches_removed.description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches_removed.name: Hide content warnings
patches_removed.description: Adds an option to play videos TikTok has classified without the warning overlay asking to be tapped through first. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches_removed.name: Show seekbar
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_removed.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_removed.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_removed.name: Uncap the refresh rate
patches_removed.description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches_modified.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches_modified.description: Ignores the creator's Duet and Stitch setting so the entries appear for videos that closed them. Everything else the app checks still applies: a photo post, a private video or one with music it may not reuse is still refused, and whether the upload is accepted is the server's decision, not the app's.

patches_modified.name: Block author button
patches_modified.description: Adds a block button to the video player that blocks the account that posted the current video in one tap, with an undo action.

patches_modified.name: Comment sort controls
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's own comment sort sheet on every post, with its hot, newest, media and creator options, instead of the cut-down row an account outside the rollout is given.

patches_modified.name: Comment tools
patches_modified.description: Hides comments that contain chosen words or come from chosen accounts, turns the thumbs down on each comment into a block button, hides comments made of an image or a sticker rather than words, and adds a box above the comments that narrows them by what they say or who said it.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Adds an App behavior toggle that stops ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, explicit Firebase screen reports and crash reporting. TikTok's own diagnostics go quiet with them. Off by default.

patches_modified.name: Enable voice comments
patches_modified.description: Turns on TikTok's own voice comment recording and publishing entry points for accounts that do not have them.

patches_modified.name: Expand activity list
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the full Activity and New followers lists instead of collapsing them behind a View all button.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI labelled videos, verified accounts, series, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge and inserted cards. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from and their view, like, comment, favourite and share counts. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed.

patches_modified.name: Follow diagnostics
patches_modified.description: Reads what the server said about a follow. A follow TikTok turns down comes back looking like a success, so this reports the refusal and its reason once per session and, with diagnostic logging on, writes the whole exchange to the report.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to stop TikTok reporting that you viewed a story or a profile or that you are typing. Online status is unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Hide already seen videos
patches_modified.description: Keeps a local record of the videos you have watched and drops them from later feed pages. The record never leaves the device and can be cleared from settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches_modified.description: Stops the brand animation that plays over the comment sheet when a comment matches an advertiser's trigger word or emoji.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for each row and header control on the Inbox tab, so message requests, TikTok Tako, TikTok Shop, the stories tray and the rest can be hidden individually.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox stories
patches_modified.description: Stops the stories tray at the top of the Inbox from being built. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the suggested searches TikTok offers on the search page before you type, and stops the page asking for them. Your own search history is left alone.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_modified.description: Stops the suggested accounts list from being built on the Activity, New followers and Inbox pages. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the Live entrance in the top left corner, the caption, the music line, the action column on the right, the survey cards and the status bar, each with its own switch.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video keep TikTok's own action, do nothing, open the video's comments, save the original sound, or copy the link to the video or its sound, and can turn a press on the left or right third of the screen into a jump back or forward. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which supplies the comment control.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch for the notification saying somebody new followed you, and one for message streaks, neither of which TikTok lets you turn off. The follower switch drops the notification before Android is asked to post it, so nothing else in the drawer is affected.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Selects the lowest, highest or a target video quality for playback, adaptive streams included. A second choice caps quality on mobile data and only ever lowers it. Download quality has its own setting.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings screen to TikTok.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Asks for a second tap before a video is sent to a friend from the share sheet, and hides chosen people or share options, or the whole Send to row.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name on the feed.

patches_added.name: Remove Recycle Bin
patches_added.description: Disables the Recycle Bin and removes it from the Me tab; deleted files are removed permanently.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_added.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches_added.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches_removed.name: Remember livestream playback position
patches_removed.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of ongoing livestreams and resume from there when reopening a livestream.

patches_modified.name: Network proxy
patches_modified.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches_modified.name: Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.
